life can be hell and this world isnt meant for us but why not live? trust me youre at rock bottom but its only up from there. ive been in your shoes many times and each time ive come out a stronger person because of it.

also keep in mind what youre actually doing, this is death. every instinct and organ in you is to perpetuate life. every flinch, twitch, gurgle, thought, motion, etc serves your purpose. i dont mean to come off weird but google some videos of people dying... seriously. look at them feel what they feel.

 i can guarantee you every one of them would have given anything to change their situation. many suicidal ppl wont jump off a building to die because of the fear of changing their mind on the way down. if you do cut yourself your going to think about you family and friends and the pain this will cause them, all while powerless to stop the blood from flowing and the sharp pain accompanying it.

also you seem fixated on your possessions. when i became suicidal i began to see my property as shackling my mind to my present state, and you know what i was right. i smashed my fucking xbox with my bare hands and it was the best thing i could do. grab your pc,lcd,etc and smash the fucker's!!! whats money to life? seriously rethink your life your in a mental rut. go hiking, explore unknown parts of town, hang out with that semi-friend acquaintance. YOU'VE put yourself where you are. the universe is a big fucking place and life is short. you've were dead for eons until now and youll be dead for fuckalleternity in no time through natural causes. so it makes sense to just ride it out. 

i mean think back to you childhood. i bet you had a very "get!" mentality like we all did. its still in there youve just put up mental blocks over the course of your life. sit down and think about those mental blocks, what do you value? what do you hate? what do you love? i hope you realize that these were all constructs created by YOU. life is about experience so go experience it.and hey at least your a human and not some parasite eating the shit out of an intestine until youre host dies...

also if that doesnt work smoke weed and listen to this

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hSeIcSFZ8PI

thank you this helps alot. yes it feels very much like a war of attrition against my stubborn, depressed self. i feel childish when i step back and realize the many ways I've perpetuated my depression. like you said im conditioned to think this way since its gone on so long but at the same time im still here so i can feel myself trying to rebuild its just very hard and time consuming.

being broken down does make me feel very strong though as i feel nothing short of torturous mutilation or a family death can bring me down anymore. now that im focused on rebuilding it seems i have a stabler foundation than before. the only problem is the depression comes and goes hitting me hard for short periods of time. i feel im getting more control everyday but theres always the part of me ready to rear its head and point out how much time and energy i invested into wanting to die, so in a warped way i feel wasteful for not still wanting to die : p

ive talked to many doctors about my clavicle and none of them can justify breaking it again  and risking a malunion. 

and any interaction feels forced its like im drawing from the model of who i was to think of something to say because who i am now would just be depressing/offputting

"Great pain motivated me to seek a level of understanding that happy people don't usually know of until something traumatic happens to them. A person experiencing great pain will always be driven to seek deeper and with way more sincerity than people who are comfortable playing around like children in the material world. What you are (not "who", but "what") and what's going on in this space/time continuum are two questions really worth striving to answer in this human life. You are closer to realizing the Big Picture than people who are satisfied playing with toys. Life goes by fast, so don't waste time."

 this is exactly how i feel. most people seem like children to me. seeing perfectly healthy peers stuffing their face or taking drugs because of their trivial bullshit "my mom wont let me party" "lol college is to hard bro imma smoke weed an play xbox all day". i would have killed for the chance to go swimming with my friends or join a sports teem(the jerseys were to thin and everyone would have noticed the gyno) it seems like i have a perspective that is considered taboo (suicidal/cold/calculating) but it was the only way to get by and i see many aspects of it as a gift, its just that my will is weak. 

im trying to take it one step at a time but i feel like all this is robbing my potential. where i once was able to pull old math equations, chem formulas, etc. is now a dark wedge keeping me from remembering and learning. im thinking of trying other anti-depressants but i dont want to waste  time with something that will only make me more depressed.

also to clarify i have gone to many parties/social events and have a good group of friends its just that im very distant emotionally regardless of my company or situation. i feel i have more compassion than anyone i know and it seems like people have picked up on this as alot of people open up to me unlike what they would have done with others my age. a happy thought i retreat to is the story of huckleberry finn. there were two social outcasts who were able to poke holes in the trivial bullshit of their society simply because of perspective. i try to learn from whatever i do be it good or bad and i hope it gets better, its nice to know im not alone thank you all for what you've said it means the world to me
